class_name: 否定-無意味-テモシカタガナイ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: even if …, it can't be helped
patterns.usage_note: Says that doing or feeling this changes nothing, so there is no point in it: concessive 〜ても plus 仕方ない — 悔やんでも仕方ない, 腹を立てても仕方がない. The sibling でもしょうがない delivers the same verdict on 仕様がない and is more casual; within this entry the たって／だって variants likewise shift toward speech. 〜てしかたがない, without も, is a different pattern meaning "unbearably".

examples.ruby: 終[お]わったことをいつまでも悔[く]やんでも仕方[しかた]ない。
examples.english: There's no use going on regretting what's already done.

examples.ruby: 電車[でんしゃ]の遅[おく]れに腹[はら]を立[た]てても仕方[しかた]がない。
examples.english: Getting angry at a delayed train gets you nowhere.

examples.ruby: 雨[あめ]の日[ひ]に洗濯物[せんたくもの]を干[ほ]しても仕方[しかた]ないよ。
examples.english: There's no point hanging the washing out on a rainy day.

glosses: nothing to be done even if …
patterns.usage_note: Says that doing this changes nothing, so there is no point in it — 急かしたってしょうがない, 抱え込んだってしょうがない. It is built on 仕様がない, contracted to しょうがない, and differs from the sibling でもしかたない in register rather than meaning: しょうがない is the spoken form, 仕方ない the one that stays respectable in writing. 〜てしょうがない, without も, is a different pattern meaning "unbearably".

examples.ruby: そんなに急[せ]かしたってしょうがないよ。
examples.english: Rushing me like that isn't going to speed anything up.

examples.ruby: 悩[なや]みを一人[ひとり]で抱[かか]え込[こ]んだってしょうがない。
examples.english: Bottling your worries up on your own gets you nowhere.

examples.ruby: 壊[こわ]れたパソコンを叩[たた]いたってしようがない。
examples.english: Whacking the dead laptop isn't going to bring it back.
